query: What features can be extracted from a company's business description to predict its regional cluster?

per_column.name: industry_sector
per_column.rationale: Industry composition varies by region (e.g., semiconductors in Silicon Valley, life science hubs elsewhere), so this extracted attribute plausibly carries signal about regional cluster without restating or leaking it.

per_column.name: company_type
per_column.rationale: VC investors, startups vs established corporations concentrate differently across regions; a legitimate predictor derived from description text.

per_column.name: company_maturity
per_column.rationale: Stage distribution differs by regional ecosystem (early-stage-heavy hubs vs mature enterprise regions); plausible predictive signal, external to the focus.

per_column.name: core_tech_domain
per_column.rationale: Tech specializations cluster geographically (e.g., semiconductor/chip design, biotech genomics); carries regional signal and is not a restatement of the cluster label.

per_column.name: cloud_infra_signal
per_column.rationale: Weaker but plausible: infrastructure orientation can correlate with regional tech culture; a legitimate, if modest, predictor.

per_column.name: market_segment
per_column.rationale: B2B vs B2C mix differs across regional ecosystems; a valid external feature with modest predictive value.

per_column.name: customer_type
per_column.rationale: Target customer verticals (financial services, healthcare, tech) concentrate regionally, providing plausible signal for cluster prediction.

per_column.name: delivery_model
per_column.rationale: SaaS vs hardware vs services delivery correlates with regional industry structure; a legitimate feature, though signal is moderate.

per_column.name: hardware_software_signal
per_column.rationale: Hardware vs software orientation maps to regional specializations (hardware hubs vs software hubs); external and plausibly predictive.

judge.rationale: All added columns are semantic attributes extracted from the business description that lie outside the regional_cluster focus and none restate or leak it. Industry, tech domain, company type, and maturity plausibly carry real geographic signal because tech specializations and ecosystem stages cluster regionally, giving genuine predictive leverage beyond the raw text and the already-present lat/long. Several columns (cloud_infra_signal, delivery_model, market_segment, hardware_software_signal) are collinear with industry/tech domain and add diminishing marginal signal, so the set as a whole is a solid but somewhat redundant predictor bundle rather than a maximally diverse one.
